product_notes.DRV/c/TAF/FTC: Screened: ctsearch darunavir + PubMed D/C/F/TAF searches. 3 records: AMBER (row 25), EMERALD (row 26), DIAMOND (new, Phase 3 single-arm - task note suggesting phase 2 not confirmed: CT.gov and PMID 31879782 state Phase 3). Approval 2018 per Symtuza label. GESIDA 10418 sleep switch study (PMID 36147597) not screened for phase.
product_notes.DRV: Screened via ctsearch darunavir (63 studies) + PubMed. 10 DRV records: ARTEMIS (row 49), TITAN, ODIN, GRACE, GS-US-216-0130 (DRV/c), WRHI 052, ACTG A5257, 2LADY, MANET, NCT00460746. Existing rows 50 (POWER-1) and 51 (POWER-2) are NOT carried forward: both Phase 2b per PMID 17416261 and Prezista label (excluded list). Approval 2006 per Prezista label. Not fully screened: SUPPRESS (withdrawn), LAPTOP-type INSTI comparisons, GESIDA studies, pooled analyses.
product_notes.ATV: Screened ctsearch atazanavir + PubMed + Reyataz label. 6 records: CASTLE (row 48), AI424-034, AI424-043, AI424-045, ACTG A5202, ACTG A5257 (ATV/r arm). Approval 2003 confirmed. ATV/c (GS-US-216-0114) excluded (cobi evaluated; no separate ATV/c product). Not fully screened: SWAN/switch-to-ATV studies (NCT00120393, NCT00067782, NCT00160329), OREY NCT00337467 (Phase IIIb single-arm ATV/r monotherapy, n=61 - no publication found quickly), NCT00280969, NCT00135395, SLOAT, ATAZIP.
product_notes.RTV: ctsearch ritonavir: RTV only as PK booster in all CT.gov Phase 3 trials. Historical registrational Studies 247 (Cameron 1998, PMID 9492772) and 245/462 (Norvir label sec 14) are pre-CT.gov and phase is not stated in label/abstract, so row 52 placeholder kept (record logs verified citation/result); approval 1996 confirmed. Human check of Phase 3 status recommended.
